title: Screen Dimmer by Shardapps
shortDescription: Dim your Windows 11 desktop with a tiny tray slider, per-screen controls, six themes and optional startup.
description:
Make a bright desktop feel softer with Screen Dimmer by Shardapps, a small, open-source screen dimmer for Windows 11.

Open the compact slider with Alt+S, choose your preferred brightness, and get back to work. Adjust all displays together or select one monitor. No account is needed, and the app works offline.

USE IT FOR
• A gentler desktop during late-night reading, coding or study.
• External monitors that still look too bright at their lowest hardware setting.
• Matching the perceived brightness of different screens.
• Quickly dimming a workspace, pausing for 15 minutes, or restoring every display.

SMALL CONTROLS, USEFUL OPTIONS
• A compact flyout above the taskbar and a quiet system tray home.
• Screen selection, screen identification and brightness presets.
• Six palettes: Pearl, Midnight, Graphite, Ocean, Forest and Sunset, plus System.
• Smooth brightness changes and short transitions that respect Windows animation settings.
• Optional warm tint, configurable shortcut and adjustment step.
• Opt-in Windows startup, with a separate option to resume saved dimming.
• Immediate emergency restore with Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F12.

Built with native Windows APIs, without a bundled browser runtime. No advertising, telemetry, screen recording or keystroke recording. Preferences stay on your device.

ALPHA RELEASE
This is our first Microsoft Store alpha. Feedback and reproducible compatibility reports help shape the next release. The source and issue tracker are available at https://github.com/shardapps/screen.

Screen Dimmer changes perceived brightness through software. It does not change a monitor's physical backlight or promise battery savings. Uniform all-display dimming uses Windows desktop color processing; separate monitor levels use compatibility overlays with narrower full-screen coverage. HDR, protected video, remote sessions and true exclusive full-screen games vary by environment. Windows sign-in, lock and UAC secure screens are outside the app's scope.

Works on Windows 11 desktop PCs, with x64 and ARM64 packages.

certificationNotes: Native C++20 Win32 utility. No login or test account is required. Starts paused by default; move the slider to enable dimming. Alt+S opens the flyout; a settings icon opens Displays, Appearance and Preferences. The runFullTrust capability is required for the normal Win32 desktop process, global shortcuts, per-display click-through windows and Windows Magnification full-desktop color processing. It does not request elevation, install a driver/service, inject code, capture the screen, record keys or access the secure desktop. The StartupTask is disabled by default and only enabled through an explicit user preference. Saved-dimming resume is a separate opt-in. Emergency restore: Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F12. Select All displays and adjust the slider for uniform desktop color processing. Per-display differences or an unavailable/busy color API use compatibility overlays. Quit from the tray menu to restore the desktop. Windows 11 desktop target; x64 and ARM64 builds.
